title: 経営学入門
subtitle: Introduction to Management
educationalGoal: This course is based on the study understanding "Marketing Ability.", one of educational goals the Department of Management Informatics, you are learning basic terms and concepts related to management strategy and marketing through reading  books, disccusion and case study.
advice:
We will deepen our understanding of corporate activities that we always have contacts with in our social life, while discussing them in textbook exercises.
In this lecture, I hope you study with interest in keeping the following points in mind.
1. Since We will deal with the topic in a one-time, you will try to attend every lecture .
2. Read and prepare textbooks and collect relevant information.
3. Clarify your own questions and questions.
4. ask questions everything you are suspicious .
requiredKnowledge: Althogh you do not need any prior knowledge or skills, you need to work on the pre-assignments and attend lectures.

activityGoals.body: You can explain basic terms for management.
You can explain the relationship between management and social envirnments.

achievementLevels.ideal: You can accurately explain the keywords for management and the relationship between the strategy and the customer and the organization. In addition you can plan a part of the strategy from a specific point of view.
achievementLevels.standard: You can almost accurately explain the keywords for managemnet, and you can clearly explain the relationship between the strategy, the customer and the organization.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              We will deepen our understanding of corporate activities that we always have contacts with in our social life, while discussing them in textbook exercises.
In this lecture, I hope you study with interest in keeping the following points in mind.
1. Since We will deal with the topic in a one-time, you will try to attend every lecture .
2. Read and prepare textbooks and collect relevant information.
3. Clarify your own questions and questions.
4. ask questions everything you are suspicious .
